prompts.male:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: Questwell Wanderer garment-only FRONT overlay, transparent PNG.
Input is the already-fitted Guardian front garment for this exact body, used ONLY as the strict fit/silhouette/canvas reference. Redesign it as a Wanderer travel coat while preserving exact normalized placement, outline, sleeves, wrists, lapel opening, waist and hem. 3:4 canvas matching source. Top 23% must remain EMPTY for avatar head. Do NOT recenter/enlarge the garment.
Wanderer design: midnight ink-blue main cloth (#1A2E5A), muted slate-blue fold highlights (#3D5A9A), aged brass/gold fine single piping (#F1C75B). Practical long explorer coat, short flat shoulder-yoke seam integrated into fabric, compact tailored collar and lapels, two unobtrusive angled pocket welts, small brass fastenings. One SMALL simple four-point compass rose embroidered on each upper sleeve, and one matching understated compass-star near each lower panel; no circles/text/runes. Lower tails keep source shape but remove Guardian chevrons. Smooth single gold piping, no branching or doubled borders. Subtle vertical fold shading.
STYLE: established Questwell 64-bit-era retro RPG garment sprite, sharp pixel clusters and simplified shading, clean readable edges at 240x320. No painterly softness, airbrush, photorealism or glossy 3D.
CRITICAL: clothing only. No avatar, anatomy, hair, head, neck, hands, shirt, tie, trousers, boots, belt, mannequin, hat, bag, weapon, props, floating fragments or background. Transparent alpha outside clothing and through front opening and sleeve/torso gaps. This is FRONT ONLY; rear fabric is a separate layer. Keep source's smooth elbow and hip contour. No holes in fabric. Same design details for all bodies.
MALE: structured shoulder span and existing arm angles. On 240x320 grid neck y77 x108..130, shoulders x81..155 y88, cuffs x62..81 and x156..175 ending y173, waist y151, long tails ending near y289. Preserve proportions.

prompts.rear: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one garment component for Questwell Wanderer: the INNER REAR SKIRT fabric panel of a long midnight-blue travel coat. Input is style/color reference only. This is a single continuous flared trapezoid of opaque fabric with a gently curved bottom hem, top narrower than bottom. Interior navy #152544 and muted slate-blue vertical folds, darker than front reference. Crisp retro RPG pixel-cluster shading, subtle readable cloth folds. No gold trim, stars, piping, seams across panel, front opening or split. Actual legs will cover this rear panel in another layer, so no holes or leg-shaped cutouts. Only one fabric panel centered on transparent canvas. No sleeves, torso, lapels, avatar, anatomy, trousers, feet, props, text, floor or shadow. Real alpha outside the fabric.
